name: com.kinatraa.fmodaudio
description: A safe, simple wrapper and tooling layer on top of FMOD for Unity: cue libraries, recycle-safe handles, music slot, bus and VCA volumes, snapshots, bank loading, pluggable settings/save hooks, a setup wizard that configures a project for FMOD, and editor tools (cue library window, id picker, constants generator, runtime debugger). Requires FMOD for Unity 2.03 (installed separately).

samples.description: SFX, music with a parameter, volume sliders bound to buses, a custom settings store and per-scene bank loading.
Step-by-step instructions for building the minimal FMOD Studio project the samples and the wizard smoke test use.
